<style>
:root {
  --qc-blue: #2c3e50;
  --qc-blue-dark: #1a252f;
  --qc-blue-light: #eaf2f8;

  --qc-green: #198754;
  --qc-green-light: #eaf7ee;

  --qc-yellow: #946200;
  --qc-yellow-light: #fff4d6;

  --qc-red: #b42318;
  --qc-red-light: #fdecec;

  --qc-border: #d9dee5;
  --qc-muted: #65717c;
  --qc-background: #f5f7fa;
  --qc-white: #ffffff;
}

body {
  background: var(--qc-background);
}

#quarto-content {
  max-width: 1500px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

main.content {
    padding-top: 0.5rem;
}

.qc-dashboard-header {
  padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  background: var(--qc-white);
  border: 1px solid var(--qc-border);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
}

.qc-dashboard-header h1 {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  color: var(--qc-blue);
}

.qc-dashboard-header p {
  color: var(--qc-muted);
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.qc-status-banner {
  padding: 1.25rem;
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--qc-border);
}

.qc-status-banner.success {
  background: var(--qc-green-light);
  border-color: #a7d8b1;
}

.qc-status-banner.review {
  background: var(--qc-yellow-light);
  border-color: #e5c56f;
}

.qc-status-banner.fail {
  background: var(--qc-red-light);
  border-color: #e2a6a1;
}

.qc-status-banner h2,
.qc-status-banner h3 {
  margin-top: 0;
}

.qc-kpi-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(175px, 1fr));
  gap: 0.85rem;
  margin: 1rem 0 1.5rem 0;
}

.qc-kpi {
  min-height: 7rem;
  padding: 1rem;
  border-radius: 0.7rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--qc-border);
  background: #fbfcfd;
}

.qc-kpi.success {
  background: var(--qc-green-light);
  border-color: #a7d8b1;
}

.qc-kpi.review {
  background: var(--qc-yellow-light);
  border-color: #e5c56f;
}

.qc-kpi.fail {
  background: var(--qc-red-light);
  border-color: #e2a6a1;
}

.qc-kpi-title {
  color: var(--qc-muted);
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
}

.qc-kpi-value {
  color: var(--qc-blue);
  font-size: 1.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.qc-kpi-note {
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--qc-muted);
}

.qc-heading {
  color: var(--qc-blue);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--qc-border);
  padding-bottom: 0.4rem;
  margin-top: 1.75rem;
}

.qc-table-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.qc-table-wrap table {
  width: 100%;
}

.qc-pass {
  color: var(--qc-green);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.qc-review {
  color: var(--qc-yellow);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.qc-fail {
  color: var(--qc-red);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.qc-muted {
  color: var(--qc-muted);
}

.qc-image-group {
  margin: 1.75rem 0 2.5rem 0;
}

.qc-image-group h3 {
  color: var(--qc-blue);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--qc-border);
  padding-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.qc-carousel {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 1rem 0 2rem 0;
  padding: 0 3.5rem;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.qc-carousel-window {
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid #d9d9d9;
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  background: #fafafa;
}

.qc-carousel-track {
  display: flex;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease-in-out;
}

.qc-carousel-slide {
  min-width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: 0.75rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.qc-carousel-slide img {
  display: block;
  max-width: 100%;
  height: 32rem;
  object-fit: contain;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.qc-carousel-caption {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: #555;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.qc-carousel-button {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  z-index: 2;
  width: 2.5rem;
  height: 2.5rem;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #2c3e50;
  color: white;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.qc-carousel-button:hover {
  background: #1a252f;
}

.qc-carousel-button.previous {
  left: 0.25rem;
}

.qc-carousel-button.next {
  right: 0.25rem;
}

.qc-carousel-counter {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  text-align: center;
  color: #666;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}


.qc-pdf-viewer {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 1rem 0 2rem 0;
}

.qc-pdf-viewer iframe {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 56rem;
}


@media (max-width: 700px) {
  
  .qc-carousel {
    padding: 0 2.8rem;
  }

  .qc-carousel-slide img {
    height: 20rem;
  }
}
/* Prevent Quarto dashboard fill behavior from changing carousel layout */

.qc-carousel.html-fill-item,
.qc-carousel-window.html-fill-item,
.qc-carousel-track.html-fill-item,
.qc-carousel-slide.html-fill-item,
.qc-carousel-caption.html-fill-item,
.qc-carousel-counter.html-fill-item {
  min-height: 0 !important;
  height: auto !important;
}

.qc-carousel-track.html-fill-container {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: row !important;
  flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
  align-items: stretch !important;
}

.qc-carousel-slide.html-fill-container {
  display: block !important;
  flex: 0 0 100% !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  min-width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
}
</style>

<script>
function qcCarouselMove(carouselId, direction) {
  const carousel = document.getElementById(carouselId);

  if (!carousel) {
    return;
  }

  const track = carousel.querySelector(".qc-carousel-track");
  const slides = carousel.querySelectorAll(".qc-carousel-slide");
  const counter = carousel.querySelector(".qc-carousel-counter");

  if (slides.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  let currentIndex = Number(carousel.dataset.currentIndex || 0);

  currentIndex = currentIndex + direction;

  if (currentIndex < 0) {
    currentIndex = slides.length - 1;
  }

  if (currentIndex >= slides.length) {
    currentIndex = 0;
  }

  carousel.dataset.currentIndex = currentIndex;
  track.style.transform = "translateX(-" + (currentIndex * 100) + "%)";
  counter.textContent = (currentIndex + 1) + " / " + slides.length;
}

</script>

required_packages <- c(
  "dplyr",
  "readr",
  "tibble",
  "purrr",
  "fs",
  "htmltools",
  "knitr"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(
    required_packages,
    requireNamespace,
    quietly = TRUE,
    FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
  )
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing packages required for the QC dashboard: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

read_csv_if_exists <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  readr::read_csv(
    file = path,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}

find_images <- function(path) {
  if (!dir.exists(path)) {
    return(character())
  }

  sort(
    list.files(
      path = path,
      pattern = "\\.(jpg|jpeg|png)$",
      full.names = TRUE,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  )
}

# ============================================================
# HTML helpers
# ============================================================

escape_html <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  x <- gsub(
    "&",
    "&amp;",
    x,
    fixed = TRUE
  )

  x <- gsub(
    "<",
    "&lt;",
    x,
    fixed = TRUE
  )

  x <- gsub(
    ">",
    "&gt;",
    x,
    fixed = TRUE
  )

  x <- gsub(
    "\"",
    "&quot;",
    x,
    fixed = TRUE
  )

  x
}


# ============================================================
# Carousel generator
# ============================================================

make_image_carousel <- function(
  image_files,
  carousel_id,
  title = NULL,
  image_height = "32rem"
) {
  image_files <- image_files[
    file.exists(image_files)
  ]

  if (length(image_files) == 0) {
    return(
      htmltools::HTML(
        "<p>No images were found for this section.</p>"
      )
    )
  }

  image_files <- normalizePath(
    image_files,
    winslash = "/",
    mustWork = TRUE
  )

  image_sources <- fs::path_rel(
    image_files,
    start = fs::path_dir(knitr::current_input())
  )

  image_sources <- gsub(
    "\\\\",
    "/",
    image_sources
  )

  escape_html <- function(x) {
    x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub("\"", "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x
  }

  slides <- purrr::map2_chr(
    image_sources,
    basename(image_files),
    function(image_source, image_label) {
      paste0(
        '<div class="qc-carousel-slide">',
        '<img src="',
        escape_html(image_source),
        '" alt="',
        escape_html(image_label),
        '" style="height:',
        image_height,
        ';">',
        '<div class="qc-carousel-caption">',
        escape_html(image_label),
        "</div>",
        "</div>"
      )
    }
  )

  title_html <- if (is.null(title)) {
    ""
  } else {
    paste0(
      "<h4>",
      escape_html(title),
      "</h4>"
    )
  }

  html <- paste0(
    '<div class="qc-carousel" id="',
    escape_html(carousel_id),
    '">',

    title_html,

    '<button class="qc-carousel-button previous" ',
    'type="button" aria-label="Previous image" ',
    'onclick="qcCarouselMove(\'',
    escape_html(carousel_id),
    '\', -1)">',
    "&#10094;",
    "</button>",

    '<div class="qc-carousel-window">',
    '<div class="qc-carousel-track">',
    paste(slides, collapse = ""),
    "</div>",
    "</div>",

    '<button class="qc-carousel-button next" ',
    'type="button" aria-label="Next image" ',
    'onclick="qcCarouselMove(\'',
    escape_html(carousel_id),
    '\', 1)">',
    "&#10095;",
    "</button>",

    '<div class="qc-carousel-counter">',
    "1 / ",
    length(slides),
    "</div>",

    "</div>"
  )

  htmltools::HTML(html)
}


# PDF viewer
pdf_viewer <- function(
  pdf_path,
  title = "Embedded PDF report",
  height = "900px"
) {
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "qc-pdf-viewer",

    htmltools::tags$iframe(
      src = pdf_path,
      title = title,
      width = "100%",
      height = height,
      style = paste(
        "border: 1px solid #d9d9d9;",
        "border-radius: 0.5rem;",
        "background: #fafafa;"
      )
    ),

    htmltools::tags$p(
      class = "qc-muted",
      "If the PDF does not display in the browser, ",
      htmltools::tags$a(
        href = pdf_path,
        target = "_blank",
        rel = "noopener",
        "open the PDF in a new browser tab"
      ),
      "."
    )
  )
}

# Overview
## Run Status

```{r}
#| label: overview-run-status
#| results: asis

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Small local helpers for this overview
# ------------------------------------------------------------

overview_value <- function(data, column, default = "Unavailable") {
  if (
    is.null(data) ||
      nrow(data) == 0 ||
      !column %in% names(data) ||
      is.na(data[[column]][[1]])
  ) {
    return(default)
  }

  as.character(data[[column]][[1]])
}

overview_number <- function(data, column, default = 0) {
  value <- overview_value(
    data,
    column,
    default = NA_character_
  )

  if (is.na(value) || value == "Unavailable") {
    return(default)
  }

  numeric_value <- suppressWarnings(
    round(as.numeric(value), 0)
  )

  if (is.na(numeric_value)) {
    return(default)
  }

  numeric_value
}

overview_has_flags <- function(data) {
  if (
    is.null(data) ||
      nrow(data) == 0 ||
      !"flagged_pairs" %in% names(data)
  ) {
    return(FALSE)
  }

  any(
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data$flagged_pairs)) > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}

overview_total_flags <- function(data) {
  if (
    is.null(data) ||
      nrow(data) == 0 ||
      !"flagged_pairs" %in% names(data)
  ) {
    return(0)
  }

  sum(
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data$flagged_pairs)),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Run-level values
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pipeline_status <- overview_value(
  pipeline_summary,
  "pipeline_status"
)

start_time <- overview_value(
  pipeline_summary,
  "start_time"
)

end_time <- overview_value(
  pipeline_summary,
  "end_time"
)

duration_minutes <- overview_number(
  pipeline_summary,
  "duration_minutes"
)

patient_sample_count <- overview_number(
  pipeline_summary,
  "patient_sample_count"
)

patient_unstained_count <- overview_number(
  pipeline_summary,
  "patient_unstained_sample_count"
)

nonpatient_sample_count <- overview_number(
  pipeline_summary,
  "nonpatient_sample_count"
)

patient_flagged_pairs <- overview_total_flags(
  patient_compensaid_summary
)

control_flagged_pairs <- overview_total_flags(
  controls_compensaid_summary
)

pipeline_completed <- identical(
  tolower(pipeline_status),
  "completed"
)

patient_compensaid_review <- overview_has_flags(
  patient_compensaid_summary
)

control_compensaid_review <- overview_has_flags(
  controls_compensaid_summary
)

overall_review_required <- (patient_compensaid_review ||
  control_compensaid_review)

overall_status_class <- if (!pipeline_completed) {
  "fail"
} else if (overall_review_required) {
  "review"
} else {
  "success"
}

overall_status_label <- if (!pipeline_completed) {
  "DO NOT PROCEED"
} else if (overall_review_required) {
  "PROCEED AFTER REVIEW"
} else {
  "READY TO PROCEED"
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Status banner
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  paste0(
    '<div class="qc-status-banner ',
    overall_status_class,
    '">',
    "<h2>",
    overall_status_label,
    "</h2>",
    "<p>"
  )
)

if (!pipeline_completed) {
  cat(
    "The analysis pipeline did not complete successfully. ",
    "Review the pipeline status and error information before continuing.",
    sep = ""
  )
} else if (overall_review_required) {
  cat(
    "The analysis pipeline completed successfully, but one or more ",
    "compensAID review items require attention before continuing.",
    sep = ""
  )
} else {
  cat(
    "The analysis pipeline completed successfully and no automated ",
    "QC review items were detected.",
    sep = ""
  )
}

cat(
  "</p>",
  "</div>"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# KPI cards
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat('<div class="qc-kpi-grid">')

cat(
  paste0(
    '<div class="qc-kpi ',
    if (pipeline_completed) "success" else "fail",
    '">',
    '<div class="qc-kpi-title">Pipeline status</div>',
    '<div class="qc-kpi-value">',
    if (pipeline_completed) "Completed" else "Failed",
    "</div>",
    '<div class="qc-kpi-note">',
    escape_html(pipeline_status),
    "</div>",
    "</div>"
  )
)

cat(
  paste0(
    '<div class="qc-kpi">',
    '<div class="qc-kpi-title">Runtime</div>',
    '<div class="qc-kpi-value">',
    duration_minutes,
    "</div>",
    '<div class="qc-kpi-note">minutes</div>',
    "</div>"
  )
)

cat(
  paste0(
    '<div class="qc-kpi">',
    '<div class="qc-kpi-title">Patient samples</div>',
    '<div class="qc-kpi-value">',
    patient_sample_count,
    "</div>",
    '<div class="qc-kpi-note">processed</div>',
    "</div>"
  )
)

cat(
  paste0(
    '<div class="qc-kpi">',
    '<div class="qc-kpi-title">Unstained samples</div>',
    '<div class="qc-kpi-value">',
    patient_unstained_count,
    "</div>",
    '<div class="qc-kpi-note">used for AF extraction</div>',
    "</div>"
  )
)

cat(
  paste0(
    '<div class="qc-kpi">',
    '<div class="qc-kpi-title">Nonpatient samples</div>',
    '<div class="qc-kpi-value">',
    nonpatient_sample_count,
    "</div>",
    '<div class="qc-kpi-note">processed</div>',
    "</div>"
  )
)

cat(
  paste0(
    '<div class="qc-kpi ',
    if (patient_compensaid_review) "review" else "success",
    '">',
    '<div class="qc-kpi-title">Patient compensAID</div>',
    '<div class="qc-kpi-value">',
    patient_flagged_pairs,
    "</div>",
    '<div class="qc-kpi-note">',
    if (patient_compensaid_review) {
      "flagged pairs requiring review"
    } else {
      "flagged pairs"
    },
    "</div>",
    "</div>"
  )
)

cat(
  paste0(
    '<div class="qc-kpi ',
    if (control_compensaid_review) "review" else "success",
    '">',
    '<div class="qc-kpi-title">Control compensAID</div>',
    '<div class="qc-kpi-value">',
    control_flagged_pairs,
    "</div>",
    '<div class="qc-kpi-note">',
    if (control_compensaid_review) {
      "flagged pairs requiring review"
    } else {
      "flagged pairs"
    },
    "</div>",
    "</div>"
  )
)

cat("</div>")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Run details table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat('<h3 class="qc-heading">Run details</h3>')

run_details <- tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Pipeline status",
    "Start time",
    "End time",
    "Duration (minutes)",
    "Output folder"
  ),
  Value = c(
    pipeline_status,
    start_time,
    end_time,
    duration_minutes,
    output_folder
  )
)

cat(
  '<div class="qc-table-wrap">'
)

print(
  knitr::kable(
    run_details,
    format = "html"
  )
)

cat("</div>")
```


## Needs Review
```{r}
#| label: overview-needs-review
#| results: asis

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Build review queue
# ------------------------------------------------------------

review_tables <- list()

if (
  !is.null(patient_compensaid_summary) &&
    nrow(patient_compensaid_summary) > 0
) {
  review_tables[[length(review_tables) + 1]] <- patient_compensaid_summary |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      sample_type = "Patient"
    )
}

if (
  !is.null(controls_compensaid_summary) &&
    nrow(controls_compensaid_summary) > 0
) {
  review_tables[[length(review_tables) + 1]] <- controls_compensaid_summary |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      sample_type = "Control"
    )
}

if (length(review_tables) == 0) {
  cat(
    '<div class="qc-status-banner success">',
    "<h3>No review items detected</h3>",
    "<p>No compensAID summary results were available for review.</p>",
    "</div>"
  )
} else {
  review_queue <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    review_tables
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      flagged_pairs_numeric = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(flagged_pairs)
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(flagged_pairs_numeric),
      flagged_pairs_numeric > 0
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(flagged_pairs_numeric)
    )

  if (nrow(review_queue) == 0) {
    cat(
      '<div class="qc-status-banner success">',
      "<h3>No flagged compensAID pairs</h3>",
      "<p>No samples currently require compensAID review.</p>",
      "</div>"
    )
  } else {
    cat(
      '<div class="qc-status-banner review">',
      "<h3>Review required</h3>",
      "<p>",
      "The following samples contain flagged compensAID pairs. ",
      "Open the compensAID page to inspect the diagnostic images.",
      "</p>",
      "</div>"
    )

    review_display <- review_queue |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        Type = sample_type,
        Sample = sample,
        `Flagged pairs` = flagged_pairs_numeric,
        Status = review_status
      )

    cat('<div class="qc-table-wrap">')

    print(
      knitr::kable(
        review_display,
        format = "html"
      )
    )

    cat("</div>")
  }
}
```

# Autofluorescence Review
## AF Extraction Review

```{r}
#| label: af-extraction-review
#| results: asis

if (is.null(af_status)) {
  cat(
    '<div class="qc-status-banner fail">',
    "<h3>Autofluorescence status unavailable</h3>",
    "<p>The patient AF status table could not be found.</p>",
    "</div>"
  )
} else {
  available_count <- sum(
    af_status$af_status == "available",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  flagged_count <- sum(
    af_status$af_status == "flagged",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  other_count <- nrow(af_status) -
    available_count -
    flagged_count

  if (flagged_count > 0) {
    banner_class <- "review"
    banner_title <- "Autofluorescence review required"
    banner_message <- paste0(
      flagged_count,
      " patient sample(s) have flagged AF extraction results."
    )
  } else if (available_count == nrow(af_status)) {
    banner_class <- "success"
    banner_title <- "Autofluorescence extraction passed"
    banner_message <- paste0(
      available_count,
      " patient AF extraction result(s) are available with no flags."
    )
  } else {
    banner_class <- "review"
    banner_title <- "Autofluorescence results require review"
    banner_message <- paste0(
      available_count,
      " result(s) are available; ",
      flagged_count,
      " result(s) are flagged."
    )
  }

  cat(
    '<div class="qc-status-banner ',
    banner_class,
    '">',
    "<h3>",
    banner_title,
    "</h3>",
    "<p>",
    banner_message,
    "</p>",
    "</div>",
    sep = ""
  )

  cat('<div class="qc-kpi-grid">')

  cat(
    paste0(
      '<div class="qc-kpi success">',
      '<div class="qc-kpi-title">Available</div>',
      '<div class="qc-kpi-value">',
      available_count,
      "</div>",
      '<div class="qc-kpi-note">AF extraction results</div>',
      "</div>"
    )
  )

  cat(
    paste0(
      '<div class="qc-kpi ',
      if (flagged_count > 0) "review" else "success",
      '">',
      '<div class="qc-kpi-title">Flagged</div>',
      '<div class="qc-kpi-value">',
      flagged_count,
      "</div>",
      '<div class="qc-kpi-note">requiring review</div>',
      "</div>"
    )
  )

  cat(
    paste0(
      '<div class="qc-kpi">',
      '<div class="qc-kpi-title">Total samples</div>',
      '<div class="qc-kpi-value">',
      nrow(af_status),
      "</div>",
      '<div class="qc-kpi-note">AF status records</div>',
      "</div>"
    )
  )

  cat("</div>")

  cat('<h3 class="qc-heading">Patient AF records</h3>')

  cat('<div class="qc-table-wrap">')

  print(
    knitr::kable(
      af_status,
      format = "html"
    )
  )

  cat("</div>")

  af_flags <- af_status |>
    dplyr::filter(
      af_status == "flagged"
    )

  cat('<h3 class="qc-heading">AF issues requiring review</h3>')

  if (nrow(af_flags) == 0) {
    cat(
      '<div class="qc-status-banner success">',
      "<p>No AF extraction issues were flagged.</p>",
      "</div>"
    )
  } else {
    cat('<div class="qc-table-wrap">')

    print(
      knitr::kable(
        af_flags,
        format = "html"
      )
    )

    cat("</div>")
  }
}
```
